author: LGR
description:
Retrospective on the Digisette Duo MP3 from the year 2000! A standalone MP3 player built into a compact cassette shell letting you play digital audio through any tape player. And it syncs to a Windows PC using the parallel port! Nifty stuff, and it only gets more interesting from there.
